title: Spatial Journalism Story
description: JSON schema for Spatial Journalism Engine story configuration

rendering.description: Global rendering settings for the Three.js renderer

activateInteractionOutlines.description: When true, enables glowing outline effect on interactable objects during this scene

interactableObjects.description: Interactive 3D objects the user can click/touch to inspect

id.description: Unique identifier for this interactive object

hasInfoBox.description: Whether tapping shows an info card

enableRotation.description: Whether the object rotates when clicked

triggerMode.description: What triggers the ending sequence: audio end (default), last video end, or character opacity fade-out

triggerCharacterId.description: Character ID to monitor opacity for characterFade trigger

triggerSceneId.description: Scene ID where the ending condition is checked
